:::{#def-outcome-distribution}
#### Outcome distribution (random component)

In a regression model (@def-regression-model)
for an outcome $Y$ given covariates $\vX = \vx$,
the **outcome distribution** family (the **random component**)
is the specified distribution family that $Y$ follows given $\vX = \vx$,
such as Gaussian, Bernoulli, or Poisson,
with conditional mean $\mu(\vx) \eqdef \E{Y|\vX=\vx}$,
where observations are independent given their covariates.
:::
